translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 2 Tesalonicenses
book.title: Tesalónicagi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Irbogus Garda Narmaksad 2 Tesalonicenses

content: Pablo sogsad, Bab Dummadse anmarga gormaloye

Napidgine gwenadgan, an bemarga soged, Bab Dummadse anmarga gormalo, adi Bab-Jesús-gaya-burba igi bemar-abargi gusmoga, deyobi bela neggwebur-baidse gwae warmakmogagar, degine, we-gaya-burba-nued bela nuedgi abingamarmogagar.
Degine, anmarga Bab Dummadse gorbalo, adi dulemar-iskana-nue-iskudimalad mer anmar-ichogegar, ar ade bela dulemar Bab-Jesúsgi bensuli-guosurmalad.
Bab-Jesús ibmar sogsar, na ibmar-sogsadba imaksoggu, na unnitibali iskuedgi bemar-bargaoed, degine, bemar-ogannomarbaloed, adi bemar iskued-abin gandik gwisgumalagar.
Bab-Jesús-ulale, anmar bemar-gwen-bensurmalad, anmar-bemarga-ibmar-sogedba be imakmalad, degine, amba deyob be imakdigumaloed.
Bitigi Bab-Jesús Bab-Dummad-sabguedsik bemar-gwage-semai-guena-gadin, degine, Cristo baisursunna ibmar-itoged-nikad-sik bemar semai-gubalina-gadin.
Arbaed-igar nue-maid
Gwenadgan, anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo-nuggi an bemarga sogmar, gwenadgan-wie-itodimalad, anmar e-odurdaksamaladba nanadisurmaladgi be bangumar.
Ar bemar-sunnad nue wismalad, igi bemar-abargi anmar gudigusmala, deyob bemar anmarba damalar-gebed. Ar bemar-abargi anmar gudigusgua, arbasuli an gudigussurmalad.
Degine, binsa anmar bengir mas guchasurmalad. Suli, anmar ise-alamaknai, mutikidba, degine, ibginedba, ise-arbanai an gusmalad, adi mer anmar bemarginbi gudigumalagar.
Ar an Bab-Jesús-nuggi-barmilealidsoggu, sunna an bemarga sogenad, bemar anmar-bendakoye, degine, sunna anmar bemarse ibmar egisen-inigwele, anmar arbasmalad, adi anmar-daedba bemar ibmar-imakmalagar.
Anmar bemar-abargi gudigu, bato an bemarga sogsamalad: Ar dule-wargwen arbabisulile, mer masgi ogunnoye.
¿Ibiga deyob bemarga anmar sog be insae? Ar anmar be-itomalad, bemar gwen-gwen gwen arbasurmarye, unnila binsa gudidimarye, yogsaar gotebin-gotebin gudidimarye.
A-dulemarga anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo-nuggi bemar ega sogmar, be nue-bogidik arbadii imakmarye, adina be-arbaedgi be-sunnad be-manigi mas gunmalagar.
Gwenadgan, ibmar-nued bemar imakdimaladgi mer be wiegumar.
Ar we gardagi an-bemarga-ibmar-sogedba dule ibsabisulile, nue be dakmalo, doa-dule degi-gudimala. Dule-degi-gudimaladgi be bangumar, adi na dukin bingeguegar.
Degi-inigwele, melle a-dule be-istaradyob be dakmalo, suli, a-dule Cristogi be-gwenad be dakoed, nue be unaoed, degine, ega binsaed nue be ukoed.
Pablo gwenadgangi napi nued binsasad
Bab-Jesús-ulubgi-bogidik-itogega-dule-imaked, a-Jesús degibi ulubgi bogidik-itogega degi-sadegu bemar-imakena-gadin. Bitigi Bab-Jesús bemarba sadegu gudiguena-gadin.
Ani Pablo, garda-bergunaidgi an-sunnad ise-narmakar an-argan-sunnadgi an imak-daed, adi bemar wisigar, we-garda ani an bemarga narmaksiid. Wegibi gusgu an-gardamargi an narmak-daed:
Anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo, bitigi bemargi bela nued binsamalana-gadin. Be itomargua.
